points.title: Marking and identification
points.covers: Whether information must be marked or identified as confidential to be protected, or is protected when its nature shows it is confidential.

points.title: Business information
points.covers: Whether confidential information covers business information, such as plans, pricing and customers, and not only technical information.

points.title: Oral disclosures
points.covers: Whether information disclosed orally or visually, not only in writing, can be confidential information.

points.title: Use only for the purpose
points.covers: Whether the recipient may use confidential information only for the purpose of the agreement.

points.title: Sharing with employees
points.covers: Whether the recipient may share confidential information with its own employees who need to know it.

points.title: Sharing with advisors and contractors
points.covers: Whether the recipient may share confidential information with its agents, advisors, contractors or other third parties who need to know it.

points.title: Notice of a compelled disclosure
points.covers: Whether the recipient must notify the discloser before disclosing confidential information that a law, regulation, subpoena or court order requires it to disclose.
queries: advance notice of the required disclosure

points.title: Confidentiality of the discussions
points.covers: Whether the existence, terms or status of the parties' discussions or of the agreement must be kept confidential.
queries: existence and status of the discussions

points.title: Reverse engineering
points.covers: Whether the recipient is barred from reverse engineering, decompiling or disassembling anything that holds or embodies confidential information.

points.title: Independent development
points.covers: Whether the recipient may independently develop information, products or technology similar to the confidential information without breaching the agreement.

points.title: Information from third parties
points.covers: Whether information the recipient rightfully receives from a third party without a duty of confidentiality is outside the agreement.

points.title: No licence
points.covers: Whether the agreement grants the recipient no licence or other right in the discloser's confidential information or intellectual property.

points.title: Return or destruction
points.covers: Whether the recipient must return or destroy confidential information when the agreement ends or when the discloser asks.

points.title: Copies
points.covers: Whether, and when, the recipient may make copies or reproductions of confidential information.

points.title: Non-solicitation
points.covers: Whether the recipient is barred from soliciting or hiring the discloser's employees or other representatives.

points.title: Survival
points.covers: Whether the confidentiality obligations continue after the agreement expires or is terminated.

points.title: Retained copies
points.covers: Whether the recipient may keep some confidential information after returning or destroying it, such as backup copies or copies the law requires it to keep.

settings.label: Explain each change to the other side
settings.description: Each tracked change carries a short comment the other side may read. Off, SurfSense's comments stay in Studio.
